species.method: mash screen (read containment) against an 8-genome panel (lightweight; does not name unlisted taxa)
species.verdict: MTBC detected; no panel contaminant above threshold

trimming.command: fastp -i ERR4811184_1.fastq.gz -I ERR4811184_2.fastq.gz -o trimmed_1.fastq.gz -O trimmed_2.fastq.gz --detect_adapter_for_pe --length_required 50 --qualified_quality_phred 15 --thread 4 --json fastp.json --html fastp.html

alignment.note: A FAIL locus must be reported as 'Fail', never as susceptible. Duplicates are marked, not removed.

calling.note: Calls seen below the AF limit are reported as sub-clonal; thresholds are PLACEHOLDERS.

annotation.tool: SnpEff 5.4c, database built from NCBI RefSeq NC_000962.3 GFF3 (Bacterial codon table)
annotation.numbering: Mtb (H37Rv NC_000962.3 CDS) = WHO catalogue v2 numbering

numbering_check.method: SnpEff-derived name vs WHO-UCN-TB-2023.7 genomic coordinates for the same (pos, ref, alt)

report.title: MTB ResiFiler report (re-implementation; not the benchmarked ResiFiler configuration)
statement: The resistance call is the WHO catalogue v2 call. The evidence layer is additive and never changes it.
No accuracy figure is claimed for this pipeline. All thresholds are provisional.
notes: Low coverage at: Rv2477c. A failed locus is never reported as susceptible.
